run_faiss_bench_interrupt: run a FAISS benchmark that compares full index search against sliced subset search with configurable IVF index key and nprobe
run_faiss_index_factory_search: run a FAISS index factory benchmark that trains an IVF index on random vectors and searches with configurable nprobe
run_faiss_twostage_search: run a two-stage FAISS search benchmark that pre-builds subset indexes and merges results using a heap
review_ResultHeap_class: review the ResultHeap class that combines FAISS query results from sliced datasets using a max-heap
test_faiss_index_parameter_space: test setting FAISS index parameters like nprobe via ParameterSpace before running search benchmarks
